business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Exothermic Reaction Self-Heating Instant Meals

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (Unitary National Jurisdiction; no sub-state corporate tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Continental European tradition; codified mercantile law under Codigo de Comercio, Decreto Ley 410 de 1971; special SAS regime under Ley 1258 de 2008)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia-United States Trade Promotion Agreement (Law 1414 de 2011; in force May 15, 2012)
Colombia-European Union FTA (Law 1669 de 2013; provisional application from August 1, 2013)
Colombia-Spain Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 2005; in force 2008)
Colombia-South Korea Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 2010; in force 2017)
Colombia-Japan Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 2011; in force 2015)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: National AML/CFT architecture: Ley 526 de 1999 (creation of UIAF); Ley 1121 de 2006 (FATF implementation); Ley 599 de 2000, Codigo Penal, arts. 323-345 (money laundering and financing of terrorism); Ley 1762 de 2015 (extended criminalization and UIAF powers); Circular Basica Juridica issued by Superintendencia Financiera; Superintendencia de Sociedades AML guidance. UBO register: Ley 2155 de 2021, arts. 43-51; Decreto 830 de 2021; Resolucion DIAN 000164 de 2021, creating the Registro Unico de Beneficiarios Finales (RUBF) administered by DIAN; arts. 2.1.1.1.1 of Decreto 1074 de 2015 for definitions of controls.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation (Certificado de Existencia y Representacion Legal) of the S.A.S. after registration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent Camara de Comercio (e.g., Camara de Comercio de Bogota)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by Colombian Ministry of Foreign Affairs or delegated chamber; required only for foreign bank account opening or foreign branch filing

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney executed by each foreign shareholder or its legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary in the shareholder's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the competent authority of the issuing country, plus official Spanish translation by a Colombian Ministry of Foreign Affairs certified translator

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Legalized copies of foreign shareholder passport and, if corporate, registered certificate of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority or company registrar of the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (for Hague member states) or consular legalization at the Colombian embassy/consulate (for non-Hague states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Sworn UBO declaration and source-of-funds statement for the subscribed capital contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Founding shareholders or legal representative before a Colombian notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Colombian notarial act (notarial protocol); no apostille required for domestic registry filing

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every UBO, director, legal representative, and authorized signatory against: UIAF PEP database; Procuraduria General de la Nacion disciplinary registry; Contraloria General SIRECI; Fiscalia records; OFAC SDN List including 50-percent ownership aggregation rule; UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list; EU consolidated financial sanctions list; and Interpol notices. Any positive hit requires enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds verification, and risk committee approval. Continuous transaction monitoring is required for Swift-Wire and TT payment rails.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Unico Empresarial y Social (RUES) operated by the network of 57 Camaras de Comercio under the oversight of the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC); online at https://www.rues.org.co; name search via the homonymy certificate (certificado de homonimia) mechanism.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be rendered in Spanish using Latin-alphabet characters. Non-Latin script names must be transliterated to Spanish orthography. The full corporate name must appear with the mandatory suffix 'Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada' or the abbreviation 'S.A.S.' (Ley 1258 de 2008, art. 3). Numerals and letters are permitted; punctuation is limited; and the name must be distinctive and not cause confusion with existing registered names.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The homonymy certificate is valid for 30 calendar days. If similarity with an existing registered name is detected, the applicant may file observations and, upon formal rejection, must file a 'recurso de reposicion' before the issuing Camara de Comercio within 10 business days and a successive 'recurso de apelacion' before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio, Delegatura de Asuntos Mercantiles, under Ley 1437 de 2011, arts. 74-80. In parallel, a fresh name application with a modified distinctive token may be filed to avoid delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted only as an administrative correspondence seat for the S.A.S.; however, the food-manufacturing operation requires a physical establecimiento de comercio registered with the Camara de Comercio under Codigo de Comercio arts. 515-517 and sanitary zoning approval under Ley 9 de 1979. A virtual office alone is therefore insufficient for the manufacturing site and will not satisfy INVIMA inspection requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High: INVIMA post-registration sanitary inspection of food manufacturers is effectively universal; unannounced inspection probability within the first 12 months of operation is estimated at 85%. Municipal land-use (uso del suelo) and fire-safety (cuerpo de bomberos) visits add a recurring annual inspection risk of approximately 40%.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name homonymy certificate (certificado de homonimia) and RUES preliminary name search
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory chamber tariff as approved by Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: S.A.S. incorporation registration in RUES and issuance of Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Chamber registration tariff, approximately 0.7% of subscribed capital subject to minimum fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial authentication of private incorporation document (if elected over public deed)
Drafting of S.A.S. bylaws (estatutos) including UBO clauses and corporate governance
Impuesto de registro (registration tax) on the incorporation document
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Ley 223 de 1995, arts. 226-229; 0.7% of stated capital where the document has cuantia

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille of foreign shareholder powers of attorney and identity documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Apostille-issuing authority in country of origin (e.g., U.S. Secretary of State)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing international fee of issuing authority

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Official Spanish translation of apostilled foreign corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Traductor Oficial certified by the Colombian Ministry of Foreign Affairs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN, and domestic sanctions screening of all UBOs and officers
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for low-risk standard screening

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preliminary UBO analysis and RUBF registration preparation for DIAN
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for corporate compliance services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Administrative office address and first-month deposit (Bogota, non-manufacturing seat)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), arts. 1-5, 17, 22, 28 and 45; Codigo de Comercio, arts. 98-110 and 372-388; Decreto Unico Reglamentario 1074 de 2015, Title 3, Chapter 1; Ley 1780 de 2016 (simplified registration for small enterprises).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Camara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) operating the Registro Unico Empresarial y Social (RUES); supervisory oversight by Superintendencia de Sociedades.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitucion (private incorporation charter) per Art. 5 Ley 1258/2008, registered in the Registro Mercantil.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital (Art. 4 Ley 1258/2008); capital is freely fixed by the founders and may be paid within a maximum statutory term of two years from incorporation. No escrow account is imposed by the registry; cash contributions must be evidenced by a bank certificate at the time of payment.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 001 OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [S.A.S. NAME], adopted unanimously on [date], per Law 1258 of 2008 and the by-laws: ONE - The subscription of [___] ordinary shares by the founding shareholders is ratified and fully accepted; contributions shall be paid within the statutory two-year term. TWO - The registered office is established at [address], [city], Colombia; the legal representative must file the domicile with the Chamber of Commerce. THREE - [Name] is appointed sole legal representative, [Name] alternate legal representative, and [Name] statutory auditor, each accepting the mandate. FOUR - The secretary is directed to register this resolution and to obtain the corresponding NIT and municipal occupancy permits.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Camara de Comercio of the company's domicile - Registro Unico Empresarial y Social (RUES) online window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed corporate name through the RUES web portal or in person at the chamber's service window. The chamber issues a 'certificado de homonimia' confirming that the name is not identical or notoriously similar to an existing entity and reserves the name for 30 business days, renewable for 30 additional days upon written request.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name (three alternatives recommended)
Identification document of each founding shareholder (cedula or passport)
Pre-application name approval form (Formulario de Consulta de Homonimia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity, obtain written consent from the prior registrant or submit an alternate name; an appeal via 'recurso de reposicion' may be filed within 10 business days per the Codigo de Comercio.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarial Authentication of the Incorporation Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaria Publica of the corporate domicile (for signature authentication) or chamber-authorized notary office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitucion containing the mandatory S.A.S. by-law clauses. Each shareholder or attorney-in-fact must sign the instrument; signatures must be authenticated before a notary. If real property is contributed as capital, the constitution must be executed as a public deed (Escritura Publica).
required_dossiers: Documento Privado de Constitucion (by-laws with the clauses required by Art. 17 Ley 1258/2008)
Relacion de aportes (schedule of capital contributions)
Identification documents of all founding shareholders
Power of attorney if signed through a representative
Proposed registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies formal defects, execute a supplemental 'aclaracion' document or convert the instrument into a public deed; re-authentication of signatures may cure evidentiary deficiencies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registration with the Chamber of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Camara de Comercio - Registro Mercantil via the RUES single window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the authenticated incorporation instrument with the Chamber of Commerce through RUES. Pay the registration fee (derecho de inscripcion) and the RUES processing fee. Upon registration, obtain the 'Certificado de Existencia y Representacion Legal' (CE&RL) which evidences legal personality and the powers of the legal representative.
required_dossiers: Authenticated Documento Privado de Constitucion
Single registration form (Formulario Unico RUES) signed by the legal representative
Name reservation certificate
Proof of payment of registration and RUES fees
Document evidencing the registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Observations must be corrected and resubmitted within 30 business days of notification; failure to cure leads to rejection of the application. The applicant may file a 'recurso de reposicion' within 10 business days under Art. 87 of the Codigo de Comercio.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and NIT Issuance with DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Direccion de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - virtual RUT office or local DIAN customer service point
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the pre-registration of the company in the RUT before or immediately after the commercial registration. After receiving the CE&RL, finalize the Registro Unico Tributario and obtain the NIT (tax identification number). The registration must be completed within one month of incorporation. Request electronic invoicing authorization (resolucion de facturacion) where applicable.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representacion Legal (CE&RL)
RUT registration form
Identification of the legal representative (cedula or passport)
Proof of the registered office address
Lease or title deed of the office or production plant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUT application is rejected or queried, file a 'Solicitud de Correccion del RUT' through the DIAN virtual portal attaching the missing documents; the rectification procedure is free of charge and processed within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Legalization of Corporate Books and Registration of Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Camara de Comercio - Legalizacion de Libros de Comercio desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the corporate books (minutes book and shareholder register) to the Chamber of Commerce for legalization and sealing. In the same procedure, register the appointment of the legal representative, alternate representative and statutory auditor by filing the respective minutes and acceptance letters with the mercantile registry.
required_dossiers: Corporate books to be legalized (Libro de Actas and Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Minutes of the board or shareholders meeting appointing officers
Signed acceptance letters of the appointed officers
CE&RL and RUT
Identification documents of the appointed officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the books are rejected for formatting or numbering defects, correct the books and resubmit for legalization; re-file appointment minutes when quorum or signature defects are identified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Beneficial Ownership Declaration and Bank Capitalization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Camara de Comercio (Registro Unico de Beneficiarios Finales - RUBF) and Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia supervised banks
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the annual RUBF declaration disclosing each ultimate beneficial owner of 5% or more of the share capital. Open the corporate current account with a supervised bank, deposit the cash portion of the subscribed capital and obtain wire transfer facilities (Swift/TT) for international payments. Contributions in kind (quicklime inventory or production equipment) must be recorded in the contribution schedule.
required_dossiers: RUBF declaration forms
Certificado de Existencia y Representacion Legal (CE&RL)
RUT and NIT
Bank corporate account opening form and KYC documentation
Bank certificate of capital deposit or appraisal certificate for in-kind contributions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUBF form is returned for inaccuracies, submit an updated declaration without penalty; if the bank rejects the account opening for documentation gaps, obtain a refreshed CE&RL and reapply, and escalate to the Superintendencia Financiera if the bank refuses to serve a legally incorporated S.A.S.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos (INVIMA) - Subdireccion de Registros Sanitarios, coordinated with the municipal or district health secretariat
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro Sanitario de Alimentos (sanitary registration of the self-heating food product) and Permiso Sanitario de Funcionamiento del Establecimiento de Alimentos (sanitary operating authorization of the processing plant)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) or the regional autonomous corporation (Corporacion Autonoma Regional, CAR) with jurisdiction over the plant site
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category II (moderate impact) under Decreto 1076 de 2015: registration-level environmental assessment with an Environmental Management Plan (Plan de Manejo Ambiental) and a water discharge permit (Permiso de Vertimientos); a full EIA report is not required unless the plant generates more than 12 tonnes per day of solid waste or handles hazardous quicklime (CaO) powders in quantities exceeding the regional threshold.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Discharges to surface waters must comply with Resolucion 0631 de 2015 for food manufacturing: pH 6.0-9.0, BOD5 <= 50 mg/L, COD <= 150 mg/L, TSS <= 50 mg/L, fats and oils <= 20 mg/L. Air emissions of particulate matter from the exothermic powder handling area must not exceed 1.0 g/h per point source per Resolucion 909 de 2008; VOCs from heat-seal packaging lines require a dispersion model where emissions exceed 5 kg/day. Hazardous waste (hydrated lime and packaging trim) must be managed and reported under Resolucion 1362 de 2007.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate issued by the Cuerpo de Bomberos (fire department) covering thermal exothermic reaction areas; structural load inspection and occupancy certification (certificado de uso de suelo) from the municipal planning secretariat; and workplace safety clearance under the SGSST system of Decreto 1072 de 2015, including ARL affiliation of all workers and a heat-exposure and chemical handling protocol for the self-heating pot production line.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – Colombian National Directorate of Taxes and Customs. Primary electronic portal: MUISCA (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicios y Control Automatizado) via https://www.dian.gov.co; taxpayer registration and daily compliance are administered through the Sede Electrónica (RUT/FE modules).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: STEP 1: Incorporate the S.A.S. before a Colombian notary and register with the local Cámara de Comercio; the incorporation act must appoint a legal representative resident in Colombia with authority to bind the entity before DIAN. STEP 2: The Cámara de Comercio system automatically assigns a provisional NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria); thereafter, the S.A.S. must complete the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) through the MUISCA platform, declaring its status as 'Responsable de IVA', income-tax payer, and, if applicable, as exporter. STEP 3: Obtain the DIAN-issued digital signature (certificado de firma electrónica) to transact electronically and to issue electronic invoices. STEP 4: If the entity will engage in foreign trade, register in DIAN's export registry as 'Usuario Aduanero' and activate the e-customs profile. Foreign shareholders require no local TIN to hold ownership; all filings are made under the entity's NIT.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia has no IRS-style check-the-box regime; an S.A.S. is always a separate taxpayer subject to Colombian corporate income tax at the entity level, with no statutory pass-through election available. The principal available elections relevant to an S.A.S. exporter are: (i) voluntary adherence to the Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE) under Articles 908–922 of the Estatuto Tributario, subject to rigorous turnover caps (gross income below 100,000 UVT at entry, with phase-outs), activity restrictions, and prohibition for sub-holdings or entities that are part of groups exceeding the cap; (ii) election by DIAN for 'Gran Contribuyente' status based on asset/turnover thresholds, which centralizes tax administration and accelerates refund processing; (iii) for cross-border financing structures, election of the tax-treatment characterization of instruments under the general anti-abuse and hybrid mismatch neutralization rules of Law 2010 of 2019 (BEPS Action 2), but no entity-classification election is available at the S.A.S. level.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA – Impuesto al Valor Agregado (Value Added Tax), governed by Articles 420 et seq. of the Estatuto Tributario (E.T.)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: COP 0 for legal entities: every capital company (including an S.A.S.) performing taxable acts on Colombian territory or importing goods is mandatorily registered as an IVA 'responsable' in the RUT from the first taxable operation, irrespective of turnover. A simplified 'no responsable' status exists only for natural persons with gross income not exceeding 3,500 UVT (approx. COP 161 million for 2025) who do not import or export goods; such status is not available to the S.A.S.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Facturación Electrónica de Venta – FE) for all IVA-responsible taxpayers. Invoices must be generated in XML, digitally signed with the DIAN-issued certificate, and transmitted to DIAN via the MUISCA/DSI platform; DIAN performs near-real-time validation and the invoice is legally valid only upon its approval, requiring the unique code CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) for sales invoices or CUDS (Código Único de Documento Soporte) for export-supporting documents and special transactions. QR code generation and embedded CUFE hash are compulsory, and export invoices must reconcile with the corresponding Export Customs Declaration (DEX). Daily batch reporting of electronic invoice events (rechazo, aceptación, recibo) is mandatory, as is the electronic transmission of all export-related data areas within DIAN's numeration and validation framework.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Article 481 E.T., exports of tangible goods are zero-rated (0% IVA), and the export sale is situated outside the taxable VAT base in Colombia. The exporter must: (i) be an IVA-responsible taxpayer; (ii) effect a definitive export of goods from Colombian customs territory, evidenced by a valid DEX; (iii) issue an electronic export invoice containing CUFE and export-specific fields; (iv) prove the physical exit of goods through transport documents and customs validation; and (v) repatriate the proceeds through an intermediary of the foreign exchange market (IMC) within the statutory term. Export-related services rendered exclusively to non-residents (e.g., logistics, loading, and technical services subject to the 'servicios vinculados a operaciones de exportación' conditions of Article 481) may also qualify for zero-rating. The exporter may simultaneously claim the refund (devolución) of IVA paid on raw materials and services physically incorporated into or used in the production of the exported goods.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Export Customs Declaration (DEX – Declaración de Exportación) accepted, validated, and definitively shipped by DIAN customs
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (transport document evidencing physical departure from Colombian customs territory)
Commercial Invoice (matching the DEX in value, product, and Exporter registry data)
Packing List (vendor's packing list detailing contents, HS codes, weights, and units)

Inward Remittance Certificate – 'Certificado del reintegro de divisas' issued by the authorized Colombian bank/intermediary (IMC) proving the foreign currency inflow and FX-market channeling within the statutory deadline
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN and external auditors apply strict substance review to export zero-rating and VAT refund claims. If the export is not fully evidenced or the goods never legally left Colombia, DIAN will: (i) assess the unpaid 19% IVA on the sale plus daily moratory interest measured from the date the refund was granted; (ii) impose the sanción por inexactitud under Article 647 E.T., up to 200% of the greater of the understated VAT or overclaimed refund; (iii) order retrospective clawback of all VAT refunds paid on inputs of the non-exported goods; (iv) in cases of organized evasion, apply the criminal offense of defraudación a la DIAN under Article 402 of the Código Penal, carrying imprisonment terms of up to 9 years, fines equivalent to up to 200% of the evaded sum, and disqualification from contracting with the State; and (v) exclude the exporter from the Registro de Exportadores and suspend future refund filings for two or more taxable periods. To mitigate audit risk, the exporter must retain the complete documentary chain (DEX, transport title, IMC repatriation certificate, commercial contracts) for at least five years, in accordance with Article 632 E.T. document-retention rules.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia), operating under the Colombian Foreign Exchange Regime (Régimen Cambiario) established by Decree 1068 of 2015, Resolución Externa No. 1 of 2018, and Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83; as from Decree 1193 of 2023, the DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) exercises foreign exchange supervision and enforcement functions, while the Banco de la República retains authority over monetary policy, international reserves, the payment system, and the exchange market infrastructure.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a managed, market-based convertibility regime for the Colombian peso (COP): current-account transactions (goods, services, royalties, and dividend remittances) are freely convertible once channeled through an authorized Intermediario del Mercado Cambiario (IMC); capital-account operations (foreign direct investment, external credits, and capital repatriation) are likewise permitted but are conditioned on the registration of the investment and the filing of the corresponding Declaración de Cambio. For the S.A.S. engaged in ISIC 1079 self-heating food manufacturing, profit remittance and capital repatriation hurdles are documentary rather than licensing-based: registration of the foreign investment within six months of the inflow, the mandatory channeling threshold of US$10,000 per transaction, the requirement to maintain a Colombian tax identification (NIT) and registered legal representation, and the obligation to preserve exchange declarations for audit by the DIAN. No prior Central Bank approval is required for lawful commercial transfers, and profit remittance is legally enforceable once the investment registration is perfected.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83, export proceeds derived from the sale of goods (Formulario No. 2 – Declaración de Cambio por Exportaciones de Bienes) must be channeled through an authorized IMC within six (6) months from the due date of the export credit (fecha de vencimiento del crédito de la exportación), supported by the customs export declaration (DEX). There is no fixed statutory percentage requiring compulsory conversion of export receipts into COP; however, 100% of the commercial value of the exported goods, net of permitted deductions and financing costs, must be repatriated and channeled to Colombia. The resulting FX balance must be maintained either in the exporter's foreign-currency account (Cuenta en Moneda Extranjera – CME) held at an IMC or converted and settled in COP within the same channeling window. Export operations below US$10,000 per transaction are exempt from mandatory channeling but remain subject to documentary preservation and to the IMC's anti-fragmentation aggregation rights for related transactions.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operating Account (Cuenta Corriente) and USD Foreign-Currency Account (Cuenta en Moneda Extranjera – CME) for export collections
Operating Account and US Dollar Clearing Account (CME) for inbound FDI and trade settlement operations
Operating Account with designated foreign-trade sub-account supporting documentary Letters of Credit and SWIFT-based disbursements
Operating Account in COP and EUR/USD Collections Account maintained under IMC rules for cross-border receipts

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for core regulatory purposes and Medium only as an auxiliary rail. Offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Currencycloud, Mercury, etc.) are not authorized Intermediarios del Mercado Cambiario and cannot lawfully receive or settle Colombian export proceeds, import payments, or FDI declarations that are subject to mandatory channeling. Use of an offshore EMI to bypass the IMC creates an unmet canalización obligation and exposes the S.A.S. to DIAN and Banco de la República enforcement actions. Offshore EMIs may be used only for incidental operating expenses below the US$10,000 channeling threshold, e-commerce collections, corporate cards, and intra-group expense clearing, provided the local COP treasury remains consolidated at an authorized IMC and no export or investment declaration dependency is created.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Under SARLAFT (Sistema de Administración del Riesgo de Lavado de Activos y Financiación del Terrorismo) and standard tier-1 bank policies, the statutory legal representative of the S.A.S. must, for the initial onboarding interview, be physically present in Colombia or, alternatively, be represented by a locally domiciled agent holding a notarized and Apostilled power of attorney (poder) with certified identity documents. Most tier-1 banks additionally require a physical visit to the registered office or production plant of the self-heating food line before account activation. Fully remote video-KYC onboarding is not generally available for newly created S.A.S. entities with 100% foreign beneficial ownership; banks retain discretionary, risk-based flexibility for low-risk clients, but the acknowledged compliance baseline is at least one physical interaction involving the director or the attorney-in-fact, accompanied by verified copies of passports, the NIT certificate, and the Certificado de Cámara de Comercio.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly formed S.A.S. with 100% foreign beneficial ownership and no prior local tax, banking, or operational history in Colombia
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of incorporation and amended bylaws issued by the Cámara de Comercio; NIT certificate; board resolution appointing the statutory representative; notarized and Apostilled power of attorney; passport copies of all directors and beneficial owners holding 25% or more of the equity; tax references from the shareholders' home jurisdiction; contractual evidence of commercial substance (purchase orders, raw material supply agreements, production facility lease); SARLAFT risk questionnaire completed by the company's compliance officer; and a written business plan describing the self-heating exothermic meal production line.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Banking inflows expected from multiple international corridors (e.g., US, European, and Asian counterparties) with payments routed through third-party payment processors or logistics platforms
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Documented commercial invoices and signed export/import contracts; bills of lading and warehouse receipts; certificates of origin; customs declarations (Declaración de Exportación / Declaración de Importación); complete SWIFT sender information (field 59 and bank reference); payer bank reference letters; formal corporate policy prohibiting unauthorized third-party aggregators; and intercompany agreements, where applicable, evidencing the underlying commercial purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Projected turnover disproportionately high for a Low_Risk_Standard food manufacturer during the first two fiscal years
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited opening balance sheet and projected financial statements; statutory licenses including INVIMA sanitary registration, environmental permits, and fire and electrical safety certificates for the self-heating canning line; payroll and social security filings for employees; production facility photographs; stock and warehouse records; industrial insurance policies; supplier invoices for raw materials; and evidence of the manufacturing equipment purchase or lease.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Dividend or capital repatriation request submitted before the S.A.S. has completed the six-month foreign investment registration window
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Foreign investment registration application stamped by the IMC through the Declaración de Cambio por Inversiones Internacionales; copies of the incoming SWIFT MT103 evidencing the original capital injection; the shareholder loan agreement if funds were advanced as debt; the board and shareholders' minutes authorizing the dividend distribution; audited financial statements showing realized and distributable profits; tax receipts for corporate income tax and the applicable Colombian dividend withholding tax; and written confirmation from the IMC that the exchange channeling declaration has been duly filed.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder equity contributions and shareholder loans must be wired from abroad via SWIFT MT103 to the S.A.S. operating account held at an authorized Colombian IMC. The incoming message must identify the S.A.S. tax identification (NIT) in field 59, and the remitter should insert in field 72 the purpose reference 'FDI – investment registration pending' or 'external credit' as applicable. The receiving IMC records the operation through the Declaración de Cambio por Inversiones Internacionales (for equity) or the Formulario No. 4 Declaración de Cambio por Operaciones de Endeudamiento Externo (for shareholder loans) within the regulatory five-business-day declaration window. The foreign investment registration must be perfected within six months of receipt of the funds through the IMC's foreign investment registration system, thereby securing the legal right to future dividend remittances, capital repatriation, and access to the official exchange market for the corresponding COP conversions. Funds must never be routed through unlicensed EMIs or personal accounts, as any such diversion extinguishes the ability to present the lawful channeling declaration.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements for imported raw materials, self-heating componentry, and packaging machinery are cleared via SWIFT MT103 outward payments using the import channeling declaration (Formulario No. 1) filed through the IMC, supported by the underlying commercial invoice and customs declaration. For larger or secured transactions, irrevocable documentary commercial Letters of Credit (LC) are issued by the Colombian IMC under the MT700 SWIFT chain, with at-sight or deferred payment clauses, partial shipment tolerances, and presentation instructions aligned with the UCP 600. Dividend and profit remittances are routed via MT103 as investment-return channeling operations and are conditioned on the perfected registration of the underlying FDI, the payment of the S.A.S. corporate income tax, and the application of the applicable Colombian dividend withholding tax. All outgoing MT103 messages must contain the beneficiary tax identifiers and the local foreign-exchange purpose codes, and the supporting exchange declarations must be preserved in the treasury compliance ledger for a minimum of five years.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: COP/USD deliverable FX forward contracts (forwards de tasa de cambio) contracted through an authorized IMC for hedging commercial export receivables and import payables

COP/USD non-deliverable forward contracts (NDFs/NDOs) referenced to the official TRM, permissible with local and eligible offshore counterparties for synthetic hedging where physical COP delivery is impractical
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) between COP and USD for matching long-term shareholder loans, export receivables, and capital expenditure liabilities
European-style over-the-counter FX options on COP/USD acquired from authorized IMCs for corridor protection and event-risk management

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: General CIT rate 35%; no sectoral rate for food manufacturing; limited incentives include 20% CIT for free-zone industrial activities, 50% deduction for investment in science/technology/innovation projects, accelerated depreciation at four times the normal useful life, and R&D tax credit; special two-year tax stability contracts are not available for new ordinary taxpayers.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 110 (Declaracion de Renta y Complementarios, Personas Juridicas) filed electronically through the DIAN MUISCA portal ('www.dian.gov.co')
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; the income tax year follows the calendar year unless a different fiscal period is registered with DIAN
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due in the calendar year following each fiscal year-end; DIAN assigns specific deadline dates between April and June based on the last two digits of the taxpayer NIT; for non-calendar fiscal years, the filing calendar is based on the statutory year-end month

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: NIT, taxpayer name, corporate status S.A.S., primary economic activity code (ISIC 1079 / CIIU 1079) and domicile
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reference the Colombian NIT of the local S.A.S.; foreign shareholders are not named on this line

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross revenue from sale of self-heating instant meal products, export sales, and incidental income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Convert non-COP receipts into Colombian pesos using the representative market rate; report all foreign remittances received from non-resident buyers

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of sales including raw materials, exothermic heat-pack components, direct labor, and manufacturing overhead
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the heat-pack or raw material is purchased from an affiliated foreign factory, the price must be documented under the arm's-length standard and supported by the transfer pricing file

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 - Deducciones y rentas no constitutivas
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenses, royalties, financial costs, depreciation, and tax-exempt revenues subject to CIT provisions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments of royalties or interest abroad must be supported by withholding tax receipts; no deduction is allowed for payments made to a foreign beneficiary without economic substance

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income, tax rate application, foreign tax credits, prepayments, remaining tax payable or balance in favor
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If a double-taxation treaty is invoked, evidence from the tax residence certificate of the foreign recipient must be retained with the return

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers the extemporaneous filing penalty in ET Article 642: 5% of the tax shown due per month of delay (maximum 100%), subject to a minimum of 10 UVT; if no tax is due the penalty is 1% of gross income; late payment incurs default interest at the BanRep rate plus 50% until full payment

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% for dividends paid to non-resident shareholders out of profits already subject to the 35% corporate income tax; distributions made from profits that never bore corporate taxation attract an additional 35% withholding as final income tax
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The Colombian S.A.S. must obtain a current tax residence certificate from the foreign shareholder's tax authority, retain a beneficial ownership declaration, and file the corresponding withholding documentation with DIAN; the reduced treaty rate is applied at the moment of self-withholding only if the foreign recipient has no permanent establishment in Colombia and is the true beneficiary; refunds for overwithholding are requested electronically through DIAN by form Solicitudes de Devolucion
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory rates: IP royalties and technical assistance remittances 33%, debt interest 15%; applicable DTA may reduce royalty withholding to approximately 10-15% and interest to 5-15% depending on the treaty partner and limitation-on-benefits conditions

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Transfer pricing annual documentation (Local File) is mandatory where related-party cross-border transactions exceed 10,000 UVT for the tax year (UVT2024=COP47,064; 10,000 UVT=COP470,640,000); Master File is mandatory when consolidated gross revenue exceeds 150,000 UVT; a Transfer Pricing Informative Return (Formulario 120) is due in all cases where the 10,000 UVT related-party threshold is met
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia does not operate a separate ESR regime comparable to certain Latin American free-trade zones, but substance-over-form, general anti-avoidance rules, limited beneficial ownership tests, and CFC rules are enforced by DIAN; an S.A.S. without employees, premises, production activity, or business purpose will be disregarded for income tax, dividend, and DTA purposes

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentional omission of export sales, fabrication of invoices for raw materials, overstatement of manufacturing costs, or destroying accounting records in the self-heating meal production entity
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal tax evasion under Criminal Code Article 308 carries imprisonment of 48 to 108 months and a fine equal to 50%-200% of the evaded tax; DIAN inaccuracy penalty equals 100% of the understated tax or overstated loss; civil default interest accrues from the date the tax should have been paid
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed false returns are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid tax; after veil-piercing, personal assets may be subject to civil restitution, court travel bans, and imprisonment upon criminal conviction
